answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 36826 Country: India Title: I wanted to know whether it is necessary to do Fajr salah with jamah, to do imamah or be imam for any prayer during that day? Question: I wanted to know whether it is necessary to do Fajr salah with jamah, to do imamah or be imam for any prayer during that day? Answer ID: 36826 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 358/145/L=1433) It is sunnah muakkidah to offer salah with jamah. Hence one should maintain it necessarily. However, doing imamah or being Imam for any salah is not necessary, except if there is none who can become Imam in your mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
